verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank that exposes the core of this story programmatically. Bank accounts can be opened and managed through the API (column-docs-2). Transfers across all payment types can be queried from one unified endpoint (column-docs-9). Transaction and account-summary reports come in JSON, CSV and Parquet (column-docs-8). The whole API is described by a published OpenAPI spec (column-docs-10, column-probe-2), alongside an llms.txt (column-probe-1) and event webhooks (column-docs-7). That gives an agent a clean machine-readable surface with no need for screen-scraping. The other elements are thinner: monthly statements exist (column-docs-21), but the evidence does not show they can be retrieved through the API, and 'hold' state transfers (column-docs-14) only imply that pending activity is visible. missing for 10: documented API retrieval of statements and documents, an explicit pending-activity or pending-balance read endpoint, any official MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read access.
